title: Organic interface enhanced electrocatalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,9849-9875
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00554J, Review Article
Qing-Ling Hong, Xue Xiao, Xuan Ai, Huimin Liu, Guang-Rui Xu, Qi Xue, Xin Wang, Bao Yu Xia, Yu Chen
This review summarizes design, synthesis, and interfacial mechanisms of organic interfaces in electrocatalysis, emphasizing their roles in tuning structures, electronics, and environments to improve performance.
